ABOUT ERA
The Electricity Regulatory Authority is a Statutory Body established in the year 2000, in
accordance with the Electricity Act, 1999, (Chapter 145 of the Laws of Uganda), as amended
by Act No. 4 of 2022 to regulate the Generation, Transmission, Distribution, Sale, Export, and
Import of Electrical Energy in Uganda. ERA is mandated by the Electricity Act to issue electricity
Generation, Transmission, Distribution, Sale, and Import Licenses, set License conditions, and
ensure compliance to License conditions by Licensees. ERA is also mandated to establish a
tariff structure, and approve rates of charges among other functions.
As part of its Corporate Social Responsibility, ERA implements the Women in Energy Project,
which aims to motivate, inspire, and mentor the Young Female generation to make informed
Career and Life choices so as to benefit from the immense opportunities in the Energy Sector.
